health_data_processing.title: Health information for your care
health_data_processing.description: The experts you book with use your health information (intake answers, session notes and documents) to care for you. You need this on to book and while you have a session booked.
details: It covers your intake answers, the notes your expert keeps from your sessions, and documents shared for your care.
The experts you book with use it to care for you. Some clinics share records between their experts, and you can say no for each clinic.
You can turn it off after your last session.

marketing.title: News from Eleva
marketing.description: Emails about new experts, events and offers.

ai_processing.title: Session transcripts and AI help
ai_processing.description: Live transcripts of your video sessions, for your expert’s record. Off unless you turn it on.
details: Your video sessions are transcribed live, so your expert keeps a written record.
Later, your expert will be able to draft session reports from their own notes with AI that runs in the EU and is never trained on your data. They review every draft before you see it.
When you turn this off, transcription stops from your next call. Transcripts already saved stay in your session record.

deletion.title: Delete your account
deletion.description: Your upcoming sessions are cancelled and new bookings stop as soon as you confirm. We delete your account 14 days later.
erase: What you wrote for your sessions, such as your intake answers.
Choices that aren't tied to a session, such as news from Eleva.
deletion.keep: We keep your experts' session notes, the consents behind your sessions and your payment records for the time the law requires. In session notes and consents, we replace your name and account with a code. Payment records keep the details tax law requires.
deletion.sessions: Upcoming sessions are cancelled when you confirm. If you paid for one, we start your refund. Keeping your account later doesn't bring cancelled sessions back.
